args.title: Agent Loop
args.body: Call model -> run tools -> feed results back -> repeat until a plain answer. Needs a [[Verifier]] to decide when work is really done.

args.title: Verifier
args.body: The harness, not the model, runs tests before accepting 'done'. Failures go back into the [[Agent Loop]] as a repair step.

args.title: Context Compaction
args.body: Fold old turns into a summary so long runs fit the window. Used together with the [[Agent Loop]].

args.query: how does the harness know the agent loop is done?
